name: Jessica Ramos

sponsored.t: Relates to judicial diversion programs; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to judicial diversion programs; establishes a diversion part in each county; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Prohibits persons in certain relationships to members of the legislature from engaging in certain activities that are deemed an indirect interest of a legislator
sponsored.sum: Prohibits spouses, domestic or romantic partners, persons residing in the same household, or immediate family members of members of the legislature from engaging in certain activities that are deemed an indirect interest of a legislator; defines indirect interest; provides an opportunity to cure a violation of such provisions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of labor and the workers' compensation board to issue stop-work orders
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of labor and the workers' compensation board to issue stop-work orders; establishes procedure for the issuance of such orders; establishes penalties for failure to comply with such orders.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of student loan payment credit history checks in certain cases
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of student loan payment credit history checks to ascertain the payment status of a student loan of an applicant for employment.

sponsored.t: Relates to the calculation of full-time employment for purposes of the federal public service loan forgiveness program
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount of credit to be certified under the federal public service loan forgiveness program for faculty or teachers to five hours worked for each hour of lecture or classroom time.

sponsored.t: Relates to labor peace agreements and the cannabis industry wage board; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to labor peace agreements and the cannabis industry wage board.

sponsored.t: Increases short-term disability benefits
sponsored.sum: Increases short-term disability benefits.

sponsored.t: Clarifies that the statutory damages available for certain wage violations are not punitive in nature and are designed to compensate workers
sponsored.sum: Clarifies that the statutory damages available for certain wage violations are not punitive in nature and are designed to be liquidated damages rather than penalties or to compensate workers for the employer's failure to prevent wage theft and for the harm to employees that results from such failure.

sponsored.t: Relates to procedures for issuing safety and health rules
sponsored.sum: Removes certain provisions regarding public hearing and notice requirements prior to issuing safety and health rules, and notice requirements after issuing safety and health rules.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorization of treatment under workers' compensation for certain providers; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorization of treatment under workers' compensation for care and treatment of injured employees by podiatrists, chiropractors and psychologists; repeals certain provisions.
sponsored.fis: It is anticipated that eliminating the podiatric, chiropractic and psychology committees would save the Workers' Compensation Board approx- imately $5,000.00 per year currently budgeted for the various commit- tees.

sponsored.t: Relates to moneys to be credited to the general account of the unemployment insurance fund
sponsored.sum: Specifies that moneys credited to the state pursuant to section nine hundred one of the federal social security act are to be credited to the general account of the unemployment insurance fund.

sponsored.t: Requires third-party food delivery services and third-party grocery delivery services to provide the ability to include a gratuity at the same point in the online order process when the underlying order is placed
sponsored.sum: Requires third-party food delivery services and third-party grocery delivery services to provide the ability to include a gratuity at the same point in the online order process when the underlying order is placed; provides that customers shall not be required to pay a gratuity; provides that third-party food delivery services and third-party grocery delivery services shall not reduce the compensation of any worker as a result of gratuities; establishes penalties for violations of such provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires certain anti-aging skin care products to contain a warning label
sponsored.sum: Requires certain anti-aging skin care products to contain a warning label; sets forth requirements for the language, size, and placement of such warning label; establishes penalties for violating such provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the New York state workforce development board
sponsored.sum: Renames the New York state workforce investment board as the New York state workforce development board; revises the duties of the board.

sponsored.t: Relates to commissaries and canteens at correctional institutions
sponsored.sum: Relates to commissaries and canteens at correctional institutions; provides that items for sale at a commissary or canteen shall be sold for no more than a certain percentage over the purchase price; provides that the department of corrections and community supervisions shall publish on its website the price list for all commissary items for sale at each institution as of June 1, 2026 and on an annual basis thereafter.

sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory employer disclosures regarding employee compensation and benefits
sponsored.sum: Relates to mandatory employer disclosures regarding employee compensation and benefits, including any non-salary or non-wage compensation and benefits.

sponsored.t: Relates to use of accrued sick time, compensation time or vacation time
sponsored.sum: Relates to use of accrued sick time, compensation time or vacation time.

sponsored.t: Relates to fees and expenses in unemployment insurance proceedings; extending effectiveness
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions of law providing for certain fees and expenses in unemployment insurance proceedings to December 31, 2028.

sponsored.t: Relates to extending provisions of laws permitting certain deductions from wages
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions of law relating to permitted deductions from wages for an additional two years.

sponsored.t: Includes coverage of treatment rendered by a massage therapist
sponsored.sum: Includes coverage of treatment rendered by a massage therapist.

sponsored.t: Enacts the remedial construction of New York labor law act
sponsored.sum: Provides that the New York labor law shall be construed liberally for the accomplishment of its remedial purposes, regardless of whether similarly-worded provisions of federal laws or regulations have been or continue to be construed otherwise.

sponsored.t: Relates to the development of a scannable code that links to translations of work zone and truss type construction signs
sponsored.sum: Relates to the development of a scannable code that links to translations of work zone and truss type construction signs.

sponsored.t: Prohibits gas and electric corporations from recovering costs related to labor-related legal activity or workers' compensation loss adjustment expenses from ratepayers
sponsored.sum: Prohibits gas and electric corporations from recovering labor-related legal costs or workers' compensation loss adjustment expenses from ratepayers through rates, charges, surcharges, adjustment mechanisms, riders, or reconciliation mechanisms; defines labor-related legal activity.

sponsored.t: Prohibits cases from being closed without a hearing or written stipulation; repealer
sponsored.sum: Prohibits cases from being closed without a hearing or written stipulation; requires a stenographic record of all hearings held; requires minutes and decisions to be provided to the injured worker in their native language.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the impersonation of an employee organization or an employee representative
sponsored.sum: Prohibits falsely impersonating an employee organization or an employee representative with the intent to deceive the recipient and thereby cause harm to such recipient or employee organization by the use of fraud, misrepresentation, material omission, or other deception in making and disseminating a verbal, written or electronic communication; provides that the attorney general may bring an action or proceeding to enjoin such unlawful acts or practices.

sponsored.t: Requires the workers' compensation board and the department of labor to publish lists of debarred entities
sponsored.sum: Requires the workers' compensation board and the department of labor to publish lists of debarred entities as open data; directs the office of general services to maintain and publish such lists on their website.

sponsored.t: Establishes the jobs and housing pilot program to create jobs in the construction industry and address the housing crisis
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "jobs and housing act"; directs the private housing finance agency to develop and administer a jobs and housing pilot program to construct and preserve housing, including workforce housing, that is affordable to low and moderate income persons, and creates jobs for those who build and work in such housing.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring employers to obtain an acknowledgement of receipt from employees of their sexual harassment prevention policy and sexual harassment prevention training program
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring employers to obtain an acknowledgement of receipt from employees of their sexual harassment prevention policy and sexual harassment prevention training program in writing in English and in employees' primary languages; requires employers to obtain acknowledgements from employees and keep such acknowledgements for six years.

sponsored.t: Allows certain claimants to be reclassified as permanent total disability or total industrial disability due to extreme hardship
sponsored.sum: Allows certain claimants to be reclassified as permanent total disability or total industrial disability due to extreme hardship; defines extreme hardship.

sponsored.t: Enacts the anti-waiver of employment rights act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "anti-waiver of employment rights act" to invalidate any express or implied contractual provision waiving or otherwise limiting any employee's substantive or procedural rights, remedies, or claim.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of a wage data clearinghouse
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of a wage data clearinghouse to evaluate the long-term effectiveness of workforce development and education programs in the state.

sponsored.t: Requires employers of domestic workers to provide annual sick leave to such workers
sponsored.sum: Requires employers of domestic workers to provide annual sick leave to such workers.

sponsored.t: Relates to judicial review of final decisions of the public employment relations board
sponsored.sum: Relates to reviewability of final decisions made by the public employment relations board, and enforceability thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to access to prescription medication and coordination with workers' compensation board regulations governing network pharmacy use
sponsored.sum: Codifies certain regulations of the workers' compensation board relating to access to prescription medication and coordination with workers' compensation board regulations governing network pharmacy use; requires the workers' compensation board to file a report on out-of-network pharmacy use within 3 years of the effective date.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain villages in Rockland county to enter into binding arbitration
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain villages in Rockland county to enter into binding arbitration.

sponsored.t: Relates to electronic delivery of notices
sponsored.sum: Provides that electronic notice to a party is sufficient in certain workers' compensation claims.

sponsored.t: Expands the empire state apprenticeship tax credit to include additional credit for people with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Expands the empire state apprenticeship tax credit to include additional credit for people with disabilities.

sponsored.t: Expands the eligibility period for indigent legal service attorneys to receive certain loan forgiveness and increases loan reimbursement for certain attorneys who work in legal services with indigent clients
sponsored.sum: Expands the eligibility period for indigent legal service attorneys to receive certain loan forgiveness; increases loan reimbursement for certain attorneys who work in legal services with indigent clients.

sponsored.t: Requires sexual and domestic violence awareness posters in certain businesses
sponsored.sum: Requires sexual and domestic violence awareness posters in cosmetology establishments.

sponsored.t: Relates to payment of certain awards for disability
sponsored.sum: Includes the unaccrued portion of a non-schedule award in the amounts to be payable to and for the benefit of certain persons where a claimant was entitled to death benefits at the time of death.

sponsored.t: Grants the family court jurisdiction to determine guardianship of minors and infants when there are extraordinary circumstances, including parental deportation
sponsored.sum: Grants the family court jurisdiction to determine guardianship of minors and infants when there are extraordinary circumstances, including deportation, removal, or forced departure of a parent from the United States; requires the office of court administration to revise certain orders or forms used by the family court to comply with such provisions; provides that the court may, but need not, find abuse, neglect, or abandonment where extraordinary circumstances are found to exist.

sponsored.t: Relates to penalties for discrimination against employees
sponsored.sum: Increases penalties for discrimination against employees, and provides that half of such penalties go to the affected employee.

sponsored.t: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"; provides that each laborer, worker or mechanic in the employ of a contractor who by request or permission of an employer reports for work on any day shall be paid no less than four hours at the prevailing rate of wages.

sponsored.t: Relates to assessment rates for employers who have an established alternate dispute resolution
sponsored.sum: Relates to the determination of assessment rates for employers who have an established alternate dispute resolution.

sponsored.t: Relates to modular construction work
sponsored.sum: Relates to modular construction work; provides that modular construction shall comply with any existing municipal licensing requirements for all electrical, plumbing, and fire suppression work.

sponsored.t: Establishes scramble crosswalks leading to and from school buildings during times of student arrival and dismissal
sponsored.sum: Establishes scramble crosswalks leading to and from school buildings during times of student arrival and dismissal to ensure all vehicular traffic is stopped while pedestrians are crossing in the same intersection.

sponsored.t: Relates to recovery of overpayments of unemployment benefits; repealer
sponsored.sum: Provides that any claimant who has received certain unemployment benefits to which they were not entitled shall not be held liable for the amounts overpaid provided certain conditions exist; directs the department of labor to provide claimants who have previously been denied waivers with applications for individual waivers; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Relates to disqualification from receiving unemployment benefits when the claimant's employer maintained, refused or failed to cure a health or safety condition that made the environment unsuitable
sponsored.sum: Relates to disqualification from receiving benefits for separation from employment in cases where the claimant's employer maintained or refused to cure a health or safety condition that made the environment unsuitable.

sponsored.t: Provides that either party to a workers' compensation claim can request a hearing
sponsored.sum: Provides that either party to a workers' compensation claim can request a hearing; requires a record of all hearings held.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of labor to prepare an annual report on the cost of living, poverty rates and adequacy of the current minimum wage in the state
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of labor to prepare an annual report on the cost of living, poverty rates and adequacy of the current minimum wage in the state.

sponsored.t: Establishes an educator development workforce for the purpose of contracting with EDHUBNY, a nonprofit organization, for support of New York's child serving and educator workforce; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes an educator development workforce for the purpose of contracting with EDHUBNY, a nonprofit organization, for support of New York's child serving and educator workforce; authorizes the workforce to contract with EDHUBNY including performance measures, reporting requirements, and fiscal controls; authorizes collaboration with other state agencies; provides for an appropriation of $50 million.

sponsored.t: Includes a dependent allowance with unemployment benefits
sponsored.sum: Provides that a claimant for unemployment benefits may claim an additional dependent allowance in an amount equal to 5% of the state average weekly wage for the current benefit year multiplied by the number of dependents claimed in the preceding tax year.

sponsored.t: Relates to excise taxes on premium cigars
sponsored.sum: Provides that certain persons shall not be deemed a distributor for certain sales of premium cigars; provides that the tax on premium cigars shall be at the rate of seventy-five percent of the wholesale price or fifty cents, whichever is less, and is intended to be imposed only once upon the sale of any premium cigars; defines "premium cigar".

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring training to reduce abusive conduct and bullying in the workplace
sponsored.sum: Requires training to reduce abusive conduct and bullying in the workplace as part of a written workplace violence prevention program.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York youth climate corps
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York youth climate corps to support and grow climate-related service opportunities for young adults with the objective of building low-carbon and climate-resilient communities, ecosystems, and economies while providing education, workforce development, and career pathways to service members, with a focus on disadvantaged communities.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of labor to provide a document on workplace rights to any minor seeking working papers
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of labor to provide a document on workplace rights to any minor seeking working papers and to make such document available in other languages and to school officials who issue working papers.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "NYS health care tax reform act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "NYS health care tax reform act"; establishes a public goods and medicaid subsidy surcharge on insurance corporations; establishes a public goods and medicaid subsidy surcharge on business corporations; establishes a public goods and medicaid subsidy surcharge on pass-through entities; relates to filing fee surcharges; relates to revenues to be included in the health care reform act resources fund; establishes a public goods and medicaid surcharge on misclassified workers.

sponsored.t: Raises daily room and board rates at adult homes proportionally to increases in the minimum wage in New York City
sponsored.sum: Provides that admission agreements at adult homes include language providing that daily room and board rates at adult homes shall be increased when the minimum wage in New York City increases in an amount equal to the percentage of such minimum wage increase; states that such adjustment applies solely to room, board and non-medical supportive services and shall not affect Medicaid reimbursement rates.

sponsored.t: Establishes an assisted living program reimbursement program to provide enhanced Medicaid reimbursement to qualifying assisted living programs
sponsored.sum: Establishes an assisted living program reimbursement program to provide enhanced Medicaid reimbursement to qualifying assisted living programs; requires at least 70% of such assisted living facility's staff to voluntarily self-identify as Black, Hispanic, or Asian; increases the capitated rates of payment from 31% to 50% over a period of five years.

sponsored.t: Relates to fire suppression systems and licensing professionals to perform authorized work on fire suppression systems
sponsored.sum: Relates to fire suppression systems and licensing professionals to perform authorized work on fire suppression systems.

sponsored.t: Provides that certain communications between a claimant's attorney or representative and an injured employee's treating provider or a claimant's medical consultant are not improper influence
sponsored.sum: Provides that certain communications between a claimant's attorney or representative and an injured employee's treating provider or a claimant's medical consultant are not improper influence or an attempt to improperly influence.

sponsored.t: Relates to the issuance of temporary elevator mechanic licenses during shortages, continuing education for certain elevator and accessibility lift licensees, and the use of unlicensed elevator mechanics; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the determination of a verifiable shortage of licensed mechanics by the commissioner of labor for purposes of the issuance of a temporary elevator mechanic license, continuing education requirements for elevator mechanic's and accessibility lift technician's licensees, and authorizing the commissioner of labor to impose civil penalties for the employment or use of unlicensed mechanics; repeals certain provisions of the labor law related to the inspection of elevators and conveyances; amends the effectiveness of such related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to health insurance for state officers and employees who receive health insurance benefits from the state
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance for state officers and employees who receive health insurance benefits from the state to take effect immediately upon employment.

sponsored.t: Requires dental insurance coverage to be offered to employees that is effective immediately upon the starting date of employment
sponsored.sum: Requires dental insurance coverage to be offered to employees that is effective immediately upon the starting date of employment.

sponsored.t: Prohibits requiring parents or caretakers to earn a minimum wage or work a minimum number of hours to be eligible for child care assistance
sponsored.sum: Prohibits requiring parents or caretakers to earn a minimum wage to be eligible for child care assistance.

sponsored.t: Requires applicants for major projects located near an environmental justice community to submit an enhanced public participation plan
sponsored.sum: Requires applicants for major projects located near a disadvantaged community to submit an enhanced public participation plan.

sponsored.t: Amends the constitution by adding a right to privacy
sponsored.sum: Amends the constitution by adding a right to privacy.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "faithless servant reform act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "faithless servant reform act", creating a rebuttable presumption of retaliation or discrimination for certain actions of an employer; provides that the employer maintains the burden of proof in certain actions against an employee; limits an employer's remedy of forfeiture against an employee's compensation.

sponsored.t: Protects persons receiving care, employed, or otherwise present at a hospital from immigration arrests; prohibits federal immigration officers acting within the scope of their employment from entering hospitals
sponsored.sum: Protects persons receiving care, employed, or otherwise present at a hospital from immigration arrests; prohibits federal immigration officers acting within the scope of their employment from entering hospitals unless supported by a judicial warrant or order; defines judicial warrant or order.

sponsored.t: Relates to required notices for employees receiving resignation solicitations
sponsored.sum: Provides for required notices for employees receiving resignation solicitations from their employer.

sponsored.t: Relates to the mechanical insulation energy savings program
sponsored.sum: Makes technical changes to the mechanical insulation energy savings program.

sponsored.t: Mandates acceptance of the New York city identity card as a primary form of identification at all covered entities
sponsored.sum: Enacts the pro-banking act to mandate acceptance of the New York city identity card as a primary form of identification at all covered entities, including all banking organizations, foreign banking corporations, and interstate branches.

sponsored.t: Establishes the child care professionals loan forgiveness incentive program
sponsored.sum: Creates the child care professionals loan forgiveness incentive program for applicants who agree to engage in employment in the child care field; establishes the eligibility for such awards; establishes the amount and duration of such awards.

sponsored.t: Establishes a billionaire mark-to-market tax
sponsored.sum: Establishes a billionaire mark-to-market tax taxing residents with one billion dollars or more in net assets.
sponsored.fis: Year 1 Revenue: $23.3 Billion. The legislation provides an option to pay year 1 of the tax in 10 annual installments. Year 2- onward Revenue: $1.2 Billion or more

sponsored.t: Relates to unfair claim settlement practices
sponsored.sum: Relates to claim settlement practices when an insurer refuses to pay or is delaying payment of a settlement; provides a policyholder a private right of action against such insurer doing business in the state who has refused or delayed payment of an insurance claim.

sponsored.t: Provides that the commissioner of labor shall notify the chairperson of the state liquor authority of certain violations of the labor law
sponsored.sum: Provides that the commissioner of labor shall notify the chairperson of the state liquor authority of certain violations of the labor law relating to wages and hours of labor; provides that the chairperson of the state liquor authority shall suspend certain liquor licenses of such employers in violation of such provisions.

sponsored.t: Makes migrant youth under the age of 25 eligible to receive housing vouchers under the family homelessness and eviction prevention supplement ("FHEPS") program
sponsored.sum: Makes migrant youth under the age of 25 who are receiving runaway and homeless youth services eligible to receive housing vouchers under the family homelessness and eviction prevention supplement ("FHEPS") program.

sponsored.t: Provides that the commissioner of labor shall notify the commissioner of taxation and finance of certain violations of the labor law
sponsored.sum: Provides that the commissioner of labor shall notify the commissioner of taxation and finance of certain violations of the labor law relating to wages and hours of labor; provides that the commissioner of taxation and finance shall suspend certain certificates of authority of such employers in violation of such provisions.

sponsored.t: Provides business tax credit for employer provided day care
sponsored.sum: Provides employers with a tax credit in an amount not to exceed 20% of expenses incurred in providing day care services to the children and wards of its employees and in training persons employed by the taxpayer or a third party provider rendering such services; provides that to receive such credit the facility or program rendering day care services must be licensed.

sponsored.t: Establishes a credit against income tax for union dues
sponsored.sum: Establishes a credit against income tax for qualified union dues paid to a labor organization on and after January 1, 2026.

sponsored.t: Establishes an unemployment bridge program; establishes digital ad tax act; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes an unemployment bridge program and an unemployment bridge program fund to provide wage replacement to workers that do not qualify for unemployment insurance or other worker wage assistance programs and who have lost a major source of income due to lost work (Part A); establishes the "Digital Ad Tax Act (DATA)" creating a tax on digital advertising services (Part B).

sponsored.t: Requires dental insurance plans to automatically carry over a portion of the enrollee's benefit amount for use in the succeeding year
sponsored.sum: Requires dental insurance plans to automatically carry over a portion of the enrollee's unused benefit amount of up to 25% of the total benefit amount for use in the succeeding year.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York title guaranty program and the New York title guaranty corporation; repealer
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York title guaranty program to provide title insurance for real property within the state; establishes the New York title guaranty corporation to implement the New York title guaranty program.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of chemical weapons and kinetic energy munitions on civilian populations
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of criminal justice services to establish a policy prohibiting police agencies from using chemical weapons and kinetic energy munitions on civilian populations and from acquiring and stockpiling such weapons or munitions.

sponsored.t: Creates a transportation subsidy to increase access to water safety instruction
sponsored.sum: Creates a transportation subsidy to increase access to water safety instruction.

sponsored.t: Establishes workplace readiness week to educate minors in relation to their workplace rights
sponsored.sum: Establishes workplace readiness week to educate minors in relation to their workplace rights; requires eleventh and twelfth graders to receive education on workplace rights; requires a document on workplace rights to be provided to any minor seeking working papers.

sponsored.t: Establishes a rent increase exemption for certain nonprofit organizations
sponsored.sum: Establishes a rent increase exemption for certain nonprofit organizations; provides a tax abatement for limiting rent increases on nonprofit organizations in a city of one million or more persons.

sponsored.t: Establishes the early learning child care act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the Early Learning Child Care Act to impose a payroll tax on certain employers for the purposes of addressing child care affordability, accessibility, and quality for families with children under five years of age; establishes the early learning child care fund; establishes the early learning child care program to provide subsidies to covered children to attend early learning child care programs; establishes the New York state child care board.

sponsored.t: Prohibits federal corporate bailout recipients who engage in stock buybacks from receiving New York state tax credits
sponsored.sum: Prohibits federal corporate bailout recipients who engage in stock buybacks from receiving New York state tax credits within three years of engaging in such buybacks.

sponsored.t: Requires certain public schools to offer Halal food options and Kosher food options during lunch
sponsored.sum: Requires schools that have a Muslim or Jewish population greater than or equal to ten percent of the student body to offer Halal food options and/or Kosher food options during lunch.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a written policy on the use of sustained auditory dispersal tools
sponsored.sum: Creates a written policy prohibiting the use of sustained auditory dispersal tools by police agencies.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "protect our privacy (POP) act" to impose limitations on the use of drones for law enforcement purposes
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "protect our privacy (POP) act" to impose limitations on the use of drones for law enforcement purposes; prohibits the use of drones by law enforcement at concerts, protests, demonstrations, or other actions protected by the first amendment.

sponsored.t: Prohibits law enforcement agencies or officers from inquiring about immigration status
sponsored.sum: Prohibits law enforcement agencies or officers from inquiring about immigration status unless a person is booked into a detention facility or the immigration status of a person is pertinent to the criminal investigation.

sponsored.t: Requires state agencies to publish certain information in local, community and ethnic media
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "local, community and ethnic media commitment act"; requires state agencies to publish certain information in local, community and ethnic media; defines local, community and ethnic media; requires the office of general services to develop and maintain a list of local, community and ethnic media outlets.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York small contractor relief act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York small contractor relief act"; defines terms; authorizes a small contractor captive insurance company to purchase, and the New York state insurance fund shall be authorized and directed to provide, reinsurance and retrocession reinsurance for such captive insurance company, on either a quota share arrangement or facultative arrangement at a rate to be determined by the board of the fund; provides that a small contractor captive insurance company organized pursuant to this article shall not refuse to issue, renew or cancel a policy of any qualified small construction contractor based upon geographic location or line of business engaged in by such contractor; makes related…

sponsored.t: Relates to securing payment of wages for work already performed; creates an employee lien
sponsored.sum: Relates to securing payment of wages for work already performed; creates a lien remedy for all employees; provides grounds for attachment; relates to procedures where employees may hold shareholders of non-publicly traded corporations personally liable for wage theft; relates to rights for victims of wage theft to hold the ten members with the largest ownership interests in a company personally liable for wage theft.

sponsored.t: Establishes the baby bucks allowance
sponsored.sum: Establishes the baby bucks allowance to provide income to eligible participants for the last three months of pregnancy and the first 18 months of the child's life; excludes income received from the baby bucks allowance for purposes of supplemental nutrition assistance program eligibility.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the comptroller of the city of New York to enforce and investigate certain violations of the state minimum wage
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the comptroller of the city of New York to enforce and investigate certain violations of the state minimum wage.

sponsored.t: Changes the designation of the public holiday of Columbus day to Indigenous People's Day
sponsored.sum: Changes the designation of the public holiday of Columbus day to Indigenous People's day.

sponsored.t: Provides a premium reduction for physicians and licensed midwives who complete a risk management strategies course
sponsored.sum: Provides for a premium reduction for physicians and licensed midwives who complete a risk management strategies course in obstetrics or midwifery.

sponsored.t: Defines employees of the state
sponsored.sum: Defines employees of the state to include statewide elected officials, state officers and employees, legislative employees and legislative members.

sponsored.t: Requires the reporting of completed judicial training as mandated by part 17 of the rules of the chief judge of the New York state unified court system
sponsored.sum: Requires the reporting of completed judicial training as mandated by part 17 of the rules of the chief judge of the New York state unified court system.

sponsored.t: Requires a certificate of merit in proceedings to recover possession of real property
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring a certificate of merit in proceedings to recover possession of real property; requires the petition shall be accompanied by a certificate, signed by the attorney for the petitioner, certifying that the attorney has reviewed the facts of the case and that, based on consultation with representatives of the petitioner identified in the certificate and the attorney's review of pertinent documents, there is a reasonable basis for the commencement of such action; provides that where a petitioner willfully fails to provide copies of required papers and documents the court may dismiss the petition without prejudice.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state worker protection and labor enforcement fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state worker protection and labor enforcement fund to supplement the department of labor's labor law enforcement duties.
sponsored.fis: Uses resources secured through penalties imposed on employers from substantiated violations to establish a dedicated fund to support labor law enforcement.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "language barrier elimination act" to provide translations to the limited English proficient in connection with certain services
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "language barrier elimination act" to provide translations to limited English proficient individuals in connection with services provided through the department of labor, department of family assistance or department of health.

sponsored.t: Provides for the regulation of all indoor and outdoor worksites
sponsored.sum: Provides for the regulation of indoor and outdoor worksites with temperature protection standards and education, training and reporting requirements to ensure that employers provide safe conditions for their employees.

sponsored.t: Relates to submission requirements for reports of independent medical examinations
sponsored.sum: Requires reports of independent medical examinations to be submitted by electronic filing; requires such report to additionally be mailed to the claimant unless the claimant opts out.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the retail sale of spices that exceed lead level limits
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the retail sale of spices that exceed lead level limits; defines spices and types of spices; establishes acceptable lead limits for various types of spices.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing paid family leave for bereavement
sponsored.sum: Authorizes paid family leave for bereavement beginning in 2027.

sponsored.t: Requires employers to provide paid vacation time
sponsored.sum: Requires employers to provide paid vacation time which is based on the length of time employees have been employed by such employers.

sponsored.t: Relates to civil actions brought by employees
sponsored.sum: Relates to civil actions brought by employees for violations of an employer violating safety and health standards or workplace violence.

sponsored.t: Specifies methods of calculating deposits and reserves for the aggregate trust fund and reserves of the state insurance fund
sponsored.sum: Specifies methods of calculating deposits and reserves for the aggregate trust fund and reserves of the state insurance fund; provides that all computations made or directed by the workers' compensation board shall be on the basis of the survivorship annuitants table of mortality, the remarriage tables of the Dutch Royal Insurance Institution applicable to claims for accidents occurring on or before December 31, 2025, and beginning January 1, 2026 and on January 1 of each tenth year thereafter, the United States life table for the total population published by the department of health and human services and the remarriage table published by the department of health and human services and…

sponsored.t: Requires human service providers that contract with the state to pay their employees a certain minimum wage
sponsored.sum: Requires that all human services contracts between any public entity and a human services provider stipulate that the public entity will pay no less than 150% of the higher of: the otherwise applicable minimum wage in the state or any otherwise applicable wage rule or order and that the necessary amounts have been appropriated to ensure payment of such minimum wage.

sponsored.t: Establishes local wage enforcement authority in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Establishes local wage enforcement authority in the city of New York; authorizes the city of New York to establish a minimum wage that is higher than the statewide minimum wage.

sponsored.t: Relates to the convening of a human services employee wage board
sponsored.sum: Relates to the convening of a human services employee wage board; requires the commissioner of labor to convene a human services employee wage board comprised of twelve members; requires the wage board to hold hearings and report and make recommendations to the governor and legislature no later than December 31, 2025.

sponsored.t: Classifies worksite employees of professional employers as employees of the professional employer for certain insurance purposes
sponsored.sum: Classifies worksite employees of professional employers as employees of the professional employer for certain insurance purposes.

sponsored.t: Relates to notification in the case of a change to a workers' compensation claims representative
sponsored.sum: Relates to notification in the case of a change to the workers' compensation claims representative.

sponsored.t: Establishes the employee privacy act prohibiting employers from using the federal electronic employment verification system to check the employment authorization status of an existing employee or an applicant
sponsored.sum: Prohibits employers from using the federal electronic employment verification system to check the employment authorization status of an existing employee or an applicant who has not been offered employment and prohibits municipalities from requiring employers to use the federal electronic employment verification system.

sponsored.t: Requires employers to provide notice of insurance requirements for injured employees to such employees in their native language
sponsored.sum: Requires employers to provide notice of insurance requirements for injured employees to such employees in their native language; requires employers to provide notice of how to file a claim to injured workers; establishes a penalty for failure to comply with such notice requirements.

sponsored.t: Increases the minimum wage annually; repealer
sponsored.sum: Increases the minimum wage annually; provides for the enforcement of the minimum wage; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Relates to cargo bicycles with electric assist
sponsored.sum: Adds cargo bicycles with electric assist to the types of bicycles with electric assist regulated under the vehicle and traffic law; provides that no person shall operate a cargo bicycle with electric assist unless it is accompanied by proof of financial security unless otherwise authorized by local law, ordinance, order, rule, or regulation or pursuant to an agreement made on behalf of the city, town, or village.

sponsored.t: Implements automatic market rate increases for child care assistance
sponsored.sum: Implements automatic market rate increases for child care assistance such that assistance will be equal to the applicable payment rate established by the department.

sponsored.t: Requires quarterly inspections of homeless shelters
sponsored.sum: Directs the office of temporary and disability assistance to promulgate rules and regulations requiring quarterly inspections of homeless shelters.

sponsored.t: Requires the metropolitan transportation authority to publish certain information pertaining to capital project data for projects that are committed for construction on the capital program dashboard
sponsored.sum: Requires the metropolitan transportation authority to publish certain information pertaining to capital project data for projects that are committed for construction on the capital program dashboard maintained by the authority on the authority's website; requires sources of funding to be specified.

sponsored.t: Relates to decreasing the length of the suspension period applicable to certain striking workers who seek to obtain unemployment insurance benefits
sponsored.sum: Relates to decreasing the length of the suspension period applicable to certain individuals who lose their jobs due to a labor dispute, such as a strike, and who seek to obtain unemployment insurance benefits; decreases the suspension period from two consecutive weeks to one week; provides that the waiting period and suspension period shall be served concurrently.

sponsored.t: Relates to employers' obligations to report wages for the purposes of unemployment benefits, the payment of unemployment benefits, and employer penalties for non-compliance
sponsored.sum: Requires employers to report certain employees' wages for the purposes of unemployment benefits; relates to the payment of unemployment benefits, and employer penalties for non-compliance.

sponsored.t: Relates to the purchase of apparatus, materials, equipment and supplies
sponsored.sum: Relates to the purchase of apparatus, materials, equipment and supplies; excludes contracts for services related to the installation, maintenance or repair of apparatus, materials, equipment and supplies from such purchasing authority.

sponsored.t: Relates to the form of the juror qualification questionnaire
sponsored.sum: Relates to the form of the juror qualification questionnaire; provides that such questionnaire shall only require a prospective juror who is not a citizen of the United States to certify, under penalty of perjury, that they are not a citizen.

sponsored.t: Provides the carrier or employer a credit against permanent partial disability benefits for temporary partial disability payments made in excess of 130 weeks
sponsored.sum: Provides the carrier or employer a credit against permanent partial disability benefits for temporary partial disability payments made in excess of 130 weeks.

sponsored.t: Relates to metropolitan transportation authority contracts involving industrial painting and industrial coatings
sponsored.sum: Requires certain contractor, subcontractor and worker certifications for metropolitan transportation authority contracts which involve industrial painting or industrial coating work.

sponsored.t: Provides for transportation accommodation for passengers with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Provides for transportation accommodations for passengers with disabilities; requires compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 and indication for accommodations when requesting a ride; creates an on-demand vehicle accessibility fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to the overpayment of wages
sponsored.sum: Provides that recovery of wages due to a clerical error by the employer or vendor of the employer is prohibited if such clerical error did not result in an overpayment or other inaccuracy in the amount of wages paid or the time in which wages were dispersed.

sponsored.t: Establishes a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on premises in a cigar lounge
sponsored.sum: Establishes a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on premises in a cigar lounge; defines "cigar lounge"; requires cigar lounges to provide written notification warning employees of the dangers of exposure to tobacco smoke.
sponsored.fis: Increased annual license fees for the State

sponsored.t: Relates to awards to employees who prevail in actions on kick-back claims
sponsored.sum: Relates to awards to employees who prevail in actions on kick-back claims; provides that such employees shall be entitled to the full amount of what was received, liquidated damages, attorney's fees and prejudgment interest.

sponsored.t: Directs the division of veterans' services to establish a searchable database of veteran-owned businesses
sponsored.sum: Directs the division of veterans' services to establish a searchable database of veteran-owned businesses; requires the use of a special mark to indicate service-disabled veteran-owned businesses.

sponsored.t: Provides grounds for attachment and relates to procedures where employees may hold shareholders of non-publicly traded corporations personally liable for wage theft
sponsored.sum: Provides grounds for attachment; relates to procedures where employees may hold shareholders of non-publicly traded corporations personally liable for wage theft; relates to rights for victims of wage theft to hold the ten members with the largest ownership interests in a company personally liable for wage theft; relates to penalties for certain wage violations.

sponsored.t: Requires wardens or superintendents of correctional facilities to accept assistance from state and federal agencies and municipalities
sponsored.sum: Requires wardens or superintendents of correctional facilities to accept assistance from state and federal agencies and municipalities in the event of an emergency, including loss of power, heat, or water or a medical state of emergency.

sponsored.t: Relates to home care and hospice worker shortage areas and disciplines
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of health to adjust medical assistance rates of payment for certified home health agencies, managed long term care plans, hospices, long term home health care programs, licensed home care services agencies and other entities for recruitment, training and retention of direct care workers for services in shortage areas and by shortage disciplines.
sponsored.fis: None. The legislation seeks corrections and initiatives that will prevent higher costs to the state by enabling the home care and hospice systems to have adequate staff to service the patient and community need. Any rate reimbursement changes or other fiscal measures recom- mended to the Legislature and Governor by either the market study or the labor task force would be subject to future budget decision-making.

sponsored.t: Relates to the regulation of street vendors in cities with a population of one million or more; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the regulation of street vendors in cities with a population of one million or more by authorizing such cities to adopt a program to regulate street vendors; requires street vendors to obtain a permit; provides for penalties for failure to comply with such regulations.

sponsored.t: Increases the minimum wage outside of New York city and the counties of Nassau, Suffolk, and Westchester; repealer
sponsored.sum: Increases the minimum wage outside of New York city and the counties of Nassau, Suffolk, and Westchester; repeals certain provisions of law relating to exceptions to minimum wage increases.

sponsored.t: Provides that 32 hours shall constitute a legal week's work
sponsored.sum: Provides that 32 hours shall constitute a legal week's work, with the exception of farm workers and certain other employees.

sponsored.t: Requires employers provide its employees paid leave
sponsored.sum: Requires employers provide its employees paid leave and sets requirements for paid leave.

sponsored.t: Grants superior court judges the authority to issue a temporary order of protection when an action is pending in a local criminal court
sponsored.sum: Authorizes courts to hold evidentiary hearings for a temporary order of protection in certain circumstances; grants superior court judges the authority to issue a temporary order of protection when an action is pending in a local criminal court in certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Relates to prevailing wage requirements applicable to construction projects performed under private contract; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to use of public funds for prevailing wage requirements applicable to construction projects performed under private contract.

sponsored.t: Limits the number of hours certain public employees can work
sponsored.sum: Limits the number of hours certain public employees can work.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "reciprocal enforcement of claims on unpaid or reduced state entitlements act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "reciprocal enforcement of claims on unpaid or reduced state entitlements act" which requires a report on delinquent funds owed to the state by the federal government as a result of the federal government's nonpayment in contravention of a court decision and the withholding and appropriation of federal funds in an amount equal to.

sponsored.t: Relates to unlawful strikes by public employees
sponsored.sum: Relates to unlawful strikes by public employees; provides for the settlement of certain disputes relating to terms and conditions of employment of certain transit and transportation authorities.

sponsored.t: Establishes the nail salon minimum standards council act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the nail salon minimum standards council act; establishes the nail salon minimum standards council which shall investigate wages and standards within the nail salon industry and submit recommendations on minimum wages, regulations and standards for nail salon workers.

sponsored.t: Expands the scope of duties for public employers to prevent workplace violence
sponsored.sum: Expands the scope of duties for public employers to prevent workplace violence including additional training, the creation of incident logs, expanding inspections and providing the commissioner the ability to enforce such provisions to prevent workplace violence.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Building Recruitment and Incentives for Dedicated Government Employees (BRIDGE) act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "building recruitment and incentives for dedicated government employees (BRIDGE) act" which provides a service credit for members who were previously employed by the federal government.

sponsored.t: Extends protections to tenants of cooperative housing entities
sponsored.sum: Extends protections to tenants of cooperative housing entities by expanding the definition of landlord to include cooperative entities; defines cooperative entities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the applicability of the New York state labor relations act
sponsored.sum: Relates to the applicability of the New York state labor relations act if the federal national labor relations board declines jurisdictions it has previously held, determines certain provisions are outside the scope of its duties, cannot execute its duties, or where the national labor relations act is repealed or preempted so as to nullify its effectiveness.

sponsored.t: Requires public and not-for-profit libraries to provide certain workplace protections for employees
sponsored.sum: Requires public and not-for-profit libraries to implement risk evaluations and determinations, workplace trainings, and other measures for the prevention of workplace violence.

sponsored.t: Adds home care visits to existing provisions of law prohibiting health care employers from requiring a nurse to work more than such nurse's regularly scheduled work hours
sponsored.sum: Adds home care visits to existing provisions of law prohibiting health care employers from requiring a nurse to work more than such nurse's regularly scheduled work hours, including regularly scheduled home care visits.
sponsored.fis: The use of overtime to address staffing needs has resulted in increased overtime costs. This bill should result in additional new hires at more favorable rates.

sponsored.t: Requires certain large buildings to install sprinkler systems
sponsored.sum: Requires certain large buildings in the city of New York to be retrofitted with sprinkler systems that are compliant with the NY state uniform fire prevention and building code.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain penalties to be assessed against members of a limited liability company and partners of a limited liability partnership or partnership
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain penalties to be assessed against members of a limited liability company and partners of a limited liability partnership or partnership.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain injured employees or their legal representative to claim workers' compensation or to maintain an action in the courts for damages on account of such injury
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain injured employees or their legal representative to claim workers' compensation or to maintain an action in the courts for damages on account of such injury when the commissioner of labor fails to act within a certain time frame for certain violations.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state ICE-free zones act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state ICE-free zones act to prohibit the use of state or municipal property for civil immigration enforcement activity; requires signage to be posted at the entrance to state or municipal property or other areas that are accessible to the public stating that civil immigration enforcement activity is not allowed; provides an exception that civil immigration activity may be conducted on such property pursuant to a valid judicial warrant specifying that such activity may be conducted on such property for a specified purpose.

sponsored.t: Enacts the remedial construction of New York labor law act
sponsored.sum: Provides that the New York labor law shall be construed liberally for the accomplishment of its remedial purposes.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 153 TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 7388, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the labor law, in relation to enacting the "remedi- al construction of New York labor law act"" NOT APPROVED The bill would direct courts to interpret the Labor Law in favor of workers. I am a champion of New York's workers and have consistently prior- itized creating good jobs, supporting unions, increasing safety, and providing financial relief for working New Yorkers. New York's Labor Law is carefully constructed to balance the interests of employers and employees, to ensure that New York's workers are protected, businesses are protected from unfair competition, and our state continues to pros- per. To the extent that the Legislature has concerns that specific provisions of the Labor Law are being misinterpreted or need to be…

sponsored.t: Relates to certain provisions on elevator licensing and temporary elevator mechanics
sponsored.sum: Relates to certain provisions on elevator licensing and temporary elevator mechanics; relates to civil penalties for unlicensed mechanics; clarifies inspection provisions.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 26 Chapter 640 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 7944-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the labor law, in relation to clarifying key provisions around elevator licensing on examinations and experi- ence" APPROVED This bill would strengthen elevator maintenance licensing and over- sight. Among other changes to provisions in Article 33 of the Labor Law, this bill would introduce new temporary elevator mechanic licenses where there is a shortage of licensed mechanics, increase civil penal- ties for employing unlicensed mechanics, and create a new statewide inspection program that would require the Department of Labor to witness all elevator testing. These changes aim to make elevators safer across New York but do not include any new resources for implementation. I have secured an agree- ment with the legislature to operationalize this bill within existing…

sponsored.t: Relates to contracted network pharmacy use
sponsored.sum: Relates to contracted network pharmacy use.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 89 TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 4926, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the workers' compensation law, in relation to contracted network pharmacy use" NOT APPROVED This bill would change the process for obtaining prescription medica- tion to allow claimants to obtain prescriptions outside the payer's pharmacy network upon a factual finding of specified circumstances related to the medication not being authorized. This bill would increase litigation and add bureaucratic steps for the Workers' Compensation Board. Before the injured worker may go out of network, they would need to demonstrate that one of the reasons speci- fied by the bill for going out of network has occurred. Each reason permitting medication to be obtained out of network will result in factual disputes, leading to litigation before the…

sponsored.t: Establishes the mechanical insulation energy savings program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the mechanical insulation energy savings program to provide grants for qualified mechanical insulation expenditures to school districts, public hospitals, public housing buildings, and political subdivisions that have completed a qualified audit.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 3 Chapter 363 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 2457-B, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public authorities law, in relation to estab- lishing the mechanical insulation energy savings program" APPROVED This bill would establish a mechanical insulation energy savings program administered by the New York State Energy Research and Develop- ment Authority to provide grants for the purchase of insulation materi- als, facings, and accessory products for certain public buildings upon submission of a qualified mechanical insulation audit. However, certain technical changes were necessary to allow the author- ity to gradually implement this program as funding is available. These changes also ensure that funds are available that do not impact ratepay- ers while supporting the contractors performing this necessary work. I have reached an agreement with the…

sponsored.t: Relates to disputes between employers and recognized employee organizations
sponsored.sum: Provides for the applicability of the New York labor relations act.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility for classification as permanent total disability
sponsored.sum: Relates to eligibility for classification as permanent total disability; includes inability to perform the full range of sedentary work or approval for federal social security disability benefits as a result of a compensable accident or occupational disease as constituting permanent total disability.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions relating to self-employment assistance programs and other matters
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions relating to self-employment assistance programs and other matters.

sponsored.t: Extends expiration of provisions of judiciary law authorizing referees to determine applications for orders of protection while family court is in session
sponsored.sum: Extends the chief administrator of the courts' authority to allow referees to determine certain applications to a family court for an order of protection.

sponsored.t: Relates to the promotion of employment of people with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Establishes the task force to promote the employment by state agencies of people with disabilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to call centers for gas and electric corporations
sponsored.sum: Relates to call centers for gas and electric corporations.

sponsored.t: Relates to payroll records submitted by contractors and sub-contractors for public work contracts and the establishment of an online database of electronic certified payroll records
sponsored.sum: Relates to payroll records submitted by contractors and sub-contractors for public work contracts; extends the date the department of labor shall be required to develop and implement an online database of electronic certified payroll records until December 31, 2025; provides that the submission of certain electronic records shall satisfy certain requirements relating to the submission of payroll records.

sponsored.t: Requires retail worker employers to develop and implement programs to prevent workplace violence
sponsored.sum: Updates requirements for retail worker employers when developing and implementing programs to prevent workplace violence; clarifies certain provisions of the retail worker safety act.

sponsored.t: Relates to claims for mental injury premised upon extraordinary work-related stress incurred at work
sponsored.sum: Relates to claims for mental injury premised upon extraordinary work-related stress incurred at work, including claims for post-traumatic stress disorder, acute stress disorder or major depressive disorder resulting from work-related stress when demonstrated that such disorder arose out of extraordinary work-related stress attributable to a distinct work-related event or events directly related to the employment and occurring during the performance of the employee's job duties; amends the effectiveness thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to call center contractors of the state; repealer
sponsored.sum: Removes the requirement that a state call center contractor must hire employees of a former call center contractor whose contract is terminated unless provided in the contract; makes provisions of new law applicable only to the state and its public authorities or public benefit corporations.

sponsored.t: Relates to reducing work related musculoskeletal disorders
sponsored.sum: Amends the warehouse worker injury reduction program to focus on work related musculoskeletal disorders.
